1904f490f279463344c1497f8498709f.query: SELECT MIN(OrderDate) AS MinOrderDate, MAX(OrderDate) AS MaxOrderDate, COUNT(*) AS OrderRowCount FROM salesorderheader

944c8e1419e02aebe0bc7169fa37fb67.query: SELECT SUM(OrderCount) AS AnnualOrderCount, ROUND(SUM(SubTotalSum), 2) AS AnnualSubTotal, ROUND(SUM(TotalDueSum), 2) AS AnnualTotalDue, ROUND(SUM(AmountDifference), 2) AS AnnualAmountDifference, ROUND(AVG(AmountDifference), 2) AS MonthlyAverageAmountDifference FROM result;
944c8e1419e02aebe0bc7169fa37fb67.pythonCode:
# Python Snapshots.analyze executes this read-only DuckDB query
SELECT SUM(OrderCount) AS AnnualOrderCount, ROUND(SUM(SubTotalSum), 2) AS AnnualSubTotal, ROUND(SUM(TotalDueSum), 2) AS AnnualTotalDue, ROUND(SUM(AmountDifference), 2) AS AnnualAmountDifference, ROUND(AVG(AmountDifference), 2) AS MonthlyAverageAmountDifference FROM result;

ef0115a55dd7c28521ee4fd8622a3289.query: SELECT MONTH(OrderDate) AS OrderMonth, COUNT(DISTINCT SalesOrderID) AS OrderCount, ROUND(SUM(SubTotal), 2) AS SubTotalSum, ROUND(SUM(TotalDue), 2) AS TotalDueSum, ROUND(SUM(TotalDue) - SUM(SubTotal), 2) AS AmountDifference FROM salesorderheader WHERE OrderDate >= '2003-01-01' AND OrderDate < '2004-01-01' GROUP BY MONTH(OrderDate) ORDER BY OrderMonth

7cc689ee6dee3bf68abed896ad05ba94.query: SELECT OrderMonth, OrderCount, SubTotalSum, TotalDueSum, AmountDifference, '最大差额' AS ExtremeType FROM result WHERE AmountDifference = (SELECT MAX(AmountDifference) FROM result) UNION ALL SELECT OrderMonth, OrderCount, SubTotalSum, TotalDueSum, AmountDifference, '最小差额' AS ExtremeType FROM result WHERE AmountDifference = (SELECT MIN(AmountDifference) FROM result) UNION ALL SELECT OrderMonth, OrderCount, SubTotalSum, TotalDueSum, AmountDifference, '最大SubTotal' AS ExtremeType FROM result WHERE SubTotalSum = (SELECT MAX(SubTotalSum) FROM result) UNION ALL SELECT OrderMonth, OrderCount, SubTotalSum, TotalDueSum, AmountDifference, '最大TotalDue' AS ExtremeType FROM result WHERE TotalDueSum = (SELECT MAX(TotalDueSum) FROM result) UNION ALL SELECT OrderMonth, OrderCount, SubTotalSum, TotalDueSum, AmountDifference, '最多订单' AS ExtremeType FROM result WHERE OrderCount = (SELECT MAX(OrderCount) FROM result) UNION ALL SELECT OrderMonth, OrderCount, SubTotalSum, TotalDueSum, AmountDifference, '最少订单' AS ExtremeType FROM result WHERE OrderCount = (SELECT MIN(OrderCount) FROM result) ORDER BY ExtremeType, OrderMonth;
7cc689ee6dee3bf68abed896ad05ba94.pythonCode:
# Python Snapshots.analyze executes this read-only DuckDB query
SELECT OrderMonth, OrderCount, SubTotalSum, TotalDueSum, AmountDifference, '最大差额' AS ExtremeType FROM result WHERE AmountDifference = (SELECT MAX(AmountDifference) FROM result) UNION ALL SELECT OrderMonth, OrderCount, SubTotalSum, TotalDueSum, AmountDifference, '最小差额' AS ExtremeType FROM result WHERE AmountDifference = (SELECT MIN(AmountDifference) FROM result) UNION ALL SELECT OrderMonth, OrderCount, SubTotalSum, TotalDueSum, AmountDifference, '最大SubTotal' AS ExtremeType FROM result WHERE SubTotalSum = (SELECT MAX(SubTotalSum) FROM result) UNION ALL SELECT OrderMonth, OrderCount, SubTotalSum, TotalDueSum, AmountDifference, '最大TotalDue' AS ExtremeType FROM result WHERE TotalDueSum = (SELECT MAX(TotalDueSum) FROM result) UNION ALL SELECT OrderMonth, OrderCount, SubTotalSum, TotalDueSum, AmountDifference, '最多订单' AS ExtremeType FROM result WHERE OrderCount = (SELECT MAX(OrderCount) FROM result) UNION ALL SELECT OrderMonth, OrderCount, SubTotalSum, TotalDueSum, AmountDifference, '最少订单' AS ExtremeType FROM result WHERE OrderCount = (SELECT MIN(OrderCount) FROM result) ORDER BY ExtremeType, OrderMonth;
